title: Kay NDE 5315
content: I was feeling unwell from a change of medications. I then drank at least two or three energy drinks. My friends dropped by. I smoked some dope with them (just a joint, I had done this many times before). We were sitting at the table and I fainted. The next thing I knew I was in another place. It was a white room, and I was sitting on a box covered in white shag pile carpet. The door to the left was shut. I could hear kids playing outside. I had no pain and felt happy and relaxed. I was talking to someone, but I could not tell you whom it was. I got the impression that they didn't expect me there, as the person I was talking to was coming through a door. The door opened to me, and all I could see was bright light! Then, here on Earth, I heard my brother start to talk to me. He put a cold cloth on my head, and I was back. Everyone that was at the table said I looked dead. All the color had drained out of me. Not my brother, though. He said, 'She just fainted, that's all.' The funny thing is, I always wondered about white shag pile carpet - how do you keep it clean? I remember studying it while I was there. I must have been dressed in white, because I feel like I blended in. I do remember watching my hand feel the carpet. Now I am no longer able to smoke dope û it knocks me out. Why, I don't know. I've had a brain scan, everything looks good. I've given up drinking energy drinks as they make your heart go faster - too fast for me. They hooked me up to a heart machine, and my heart was going flat out. I think what happened was due to a combination of things. For one thing, when the heart stops, you have three seconds until you pass out. In my current life, I'm in pain every day, but when I was there I wasn't. I miss that place. I wonder - what if I had gone through the door?

arrival.other_being_detail: Experiencer reports talking to someone but could not identify who; got the impression the person "didn't expect me there" and was "coming through a door."

environment.environment_other_detail: A "white room"; sitting on a box covered in "white shag pile carpet"; a shut door to the left; could hear kids playing outside; when a door opened, "all I could see was bright light."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fainted after medication change plus consuming "two or three energy drinks" and smoking a joint; later reports heart was "going flat out."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Return was triggered by hearing brother talking and cold cloth on head; no explicit return choice described.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Fainting followed by immediate arrival in a white room; interaction/communication; door opens revealing bright light; then abrupt return upon hearing brother and being physically stimulated.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Focus on mundane detail: examining/feeling "white shag pile carpet" and wondering how it stays clean; hearing "kids playing outside" while in the white room.

I miss that place."; "I wonder - what if I had gone through the door?"
